pairs.question: Argumentari tibi uideor, Hermogenes?
pairs.answer: Nauiter scriptura nobis patrocinatur, quae utrumque nomen ei distinxit et suo tempore ostendit.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question addressed to Hermogenes ('Do I seem to you to be merely arguing?') immediately rebutted by Tertullian's own answer ('No — Scripture vigorously supports us, which distinguished each name for him and showed it in its own time'). Section marker '[5]' stripped. Vocative 'Hermogenes' kept as part of the rhetorical address. Answer window ends at the first full stop after 'ostendit'; what follows ('Nam deus quidem, quod erat semper...') begins the scriptural elaboration with proof-texts, so it is cut as digression.
